body.message:
Dear Mr. Shaker,

We would like to inform you that the owner has sold the apartment, and it has now been removed from the holiday homes listing. As a result, we are unable to proceed with the check-in for this unit.

However, we would like to offer you an alternative option in Business Bay – MAG 318, a 2-bedroom apartment. We can provide this unit at the same rate, even though the standard pricing is higher, as a special discounted arrangement due to the situation.

https://www.propertyfinder.ae/en/plp/rent/apartment-for-rent-dubai-business-bay-mag-318-2Q6w3EvRpAG.html

Kindly let us know if this option works for you. If not, we will proceed with a full refund of your deposit.

We sincerely apologize for the last-minute change, as this decision was made by the owner and was beyond our control.

Thank you for your understanding.
